breakdown.description: Initializing turbulent kinetic energy (k) and dissipation rate (epsilon) to exactly zero is incorrect for a RANS simulation, as it leads to a division-by-zero error in the turbulent viscosity calculation (nut = Cmu * k²/epsilon) and prevents turbulence from developing.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still sets internalField to uniform 0 for both k and epsilon files. While the agent correctly computed non-zero inlet boundary values (0.00375 for k and 0.001 for epsilon), the internalField values remain zero, which is the core of the inconsistency. The ground truth requires internalField uniform 0.00375 for k and internalField uniform 0.001 for epsilon to avoid division-by-zero errors in the turbulent viscosity calculation throughout the domain.
